about_the_game:
The "Los Angeles 1985" Original Soundtrack is a nostalgic love letter to a decade of neon lights, cassette tapes, and late-night radio dreams. Blending the shimmering pulse of synthwave with the infectious hooks of classic 80s pop, this collection of original tracks captures the spirit of the era in every beat.

From soaring synth leads and retro drum machines to lush pads and electric guitar licks, each track is carefully crafted to transport you straight to a time of roller rinks, pastel jackets, and bittersweet slow dances. Whether you're cruising down Sunset Boulevard with the top down or lost in your own romantic daydream, the music surrounds you with the emotional highs and lows of youth, love, and self-discovery.

Perfectly paired with the heartfelt stories of Los Angeles 1985, the soundtrack stands strong on its own—offering a deeply nostalgic and emotionally rich listening experience. Whether you lived through the 80s or just wish you had, this album invites you to close your eyes and go back.

Put it on. Turn it up. Feel everything.
